item.title: Inside China's approach to AI
item.description: China is pursuing AI supremacy differently from the U.S. It prioritizes state control and adoption, with officials focused on these goals.

item.title: Judge dismisses Trump lawsuit against Des Moines Register
item.description: A district judge dismissed an election interference lawsuit filed by President Trump against the Des Moines Register and its parent company, USA Today Co.

item.title: White House told to restore access to banned news outlets
item.description: A district court judge ruled the White House violated the Fifth Amendment rights of CNN, MS NOW and Politico by banning them, and granted the plaintiffs relief.

item.title: Treasury yields climb sharply
item.description: Treasury yields are rising, with the 30-year Treasury bond reaching its highest level since 2004 on Thursday, according to FactSet data.
